title: Savills APAC Research Events file
description: Shape of /data/events.json (added 2026-10-29). A wrapper object with a generated_at timestamp and a flat array of Savills event records. Events are a display-only layer on the Calendar and the Events tab: they ignore the filter bar, are not part of URL filter state and are excluded from CSV export. v1 is JSON-edit-only (no in-app form). The layout is deliberately flat so a future GitHub Action can regenerate the whole file from a shared source — see docs/MAINTENANCE.md -> 'Savills events layer'.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last edit or regeneration.

id.description: Stable unique id: '<market-slug>--<name-slug>--<6-hex hash>' (same slug style as publication ids), e.g. 'global--savills-annual-global-luxury-event--9c57dc'. The hash is the first 6 hex chars of sha1('<name>|<start_date>').

end_date.description: ISO 8601 date, >= start_date. Equal to start_date for a one-day event. (JSON Schema cannot compare two fields; js/events.js enforces the ordering and drops invalid records.)

market.description: One of the publication markets, or Regional / Global for multi-market events.

link.description: Registration or info page (opens in a new tab), or null.
